tracking.name: Track ammunition
tracking.hint: Count rounds loaded in ranged weapons with a Shots value such as 17+1(3) or 8(3i). Usages of one gun (same name and Shots) share one magazine. Attacks spend rounds, and weapons reload from the sheet (rounds badge in the ranged table) or with /reload; the swap icon (or /reload change) picks which carried magazine to load, and a magazine ejected with rounds left is kept as a partial magazine. Right-click the badge to choose the magazines or ammo items a weapon uses.

empty.name: Firing an empty weapon
empty.hint: What happens when an attack is made with no rounds loaded.

thrown.name: Thrown weapons use up the item
thrown.hint: Throwing a weapon with Shots T(...) lowers the count of the equipment it comes from, and an attack with none left is handled like an empty gun.

firearms.capped: Only {count} rounds left in {weapon}: firing {count}, not {requested}.
firearms.rofNotAdjusted: Adjust the RoF bonus by hand.
firearms.trackingOff: Ammunition tracking is turned off in the system settings.
firearms.notCarried: {weapon} reloads from "{item}", but none is carried.

chat.oldMagazine: {count} rounds stay in the old magazine.
chat.readyMany: In combat: {count} Ready maneuvers (one per turn).
chat.noTracked: {actor} has no weapons with tracked ammunition.
chat.noMatch: No weapon with tracked ammunition matches "{name}".
chat.allFull: All of {actor}'s weapons are fully loaded.
chat.partialKept: The old {item} still holds {count} rounds: kept as a partial magazine.
chat.returned: The old {item} is still full: back with the others ({count}).

config.title: Ammunition: {weapon}
config.ammoItemsHint: Carried equipment this weapon loads from (magazines, shells, arrows), one per line, in order of preference. Blank: use the weapon's Ammo field; with neither, reloads are free. Save and reopen for more lines.
config.separateHint: {usage} keeps its own magazine instead of sharing the gun's (an underbarrel launcher, a second barrel). Usages with different Shots are always separate.

firearms.choiceGone: That magazine is no longer available for {weapon}.
firearms.noChoices: No magazines or ammunition for {weapon} are carried. Right-click the rounds badge to say which items it uses.

change.title: Change magazine: {weapon}
change.hintSwap: The magazine in the weapon comes out first: with rounds left it is kept as a partial magazine (still full: back with the others). A chambered round stays.
